name: codewhale
description: First-party Codewhale extensions: the plugins and skills Codewhale ships, maintained in the open so anyone can propose a change.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: See the screen and operate it: accessibility-first control, screenshots and zoom on macOS, Windows and Linux, plus macOS recording and HarmonyOS devices over hdc.

plugins.name: cloudflare-docs
plugins.description: Cloudflare's official remote docs MCP: current Workers/Pages/storage/platform documentation search. No credentials required.

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Linear's official remote MCP: issues, projects, cycles, comments, documents. Bearer auth via LINEAR_API_KEY.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub's official remote MCP: repos, issues, PRs, Actions, code search. Bearer auth via GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: stripe
plugins.description: Stripe's official remote MCP: customers, payments, subscriptions, disputes. Bearer auth via STRIPE_SECRET_KEY — a restricted rk_ key is recommended.

plugins.name: supabase
plugins.description: Supabase's official remote MCP: projects, database, auth, storage, edge functions. Bearer auth via SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: resend
plugins.description: Resend's official remote MCP: transactional email, domains, audiences, broadcasts. Bearer auth via RESEND_API_KEY.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.description: Vercel's official remote MCP: projects, deployments, domains, logs. Bearer auth via VERCEL_TOKEN.

plugins.name: codewhale-skills
plugins.description: The Codewhale skill set as one reviewed plugin: implement, debug, test, review, verify, webapp-testing, release, handoff, research and the rest of the bundled workflow skills. Each arrives namespaced as codewhale-skills:<name>. These skills also ship inside the Codewhale binary; install this bundle to carry a reviewed copy to a host that only loads plugins.
